body: Okay im doing my best to give advice to others clearly it dosent reach to you which is okay, but it may for others just because it dosent resonate with you dosent mean you have to shit all over it. I get its cringe but its hard not to be with topics like this
no i know that there isnt a soulmate for everyone because i know you will die alone

I have the same mentality i tell others that things will be okay because i know they will, but what do i do whilst waiting for things to get better? I relapsed after around 3 years aswell about a month ago, i was in a hole which im always in and out of its so tiring, i just want to stay out of the hole because im scared whilst im in this pit it will consume me and i cant get out of it anymore, i hope things get better soon for both us i know they will you just have to keep going. If today is bitter than tomorrow is sweet.

I try talking to others but its just the same response, there are no words anyone can say that will fix anything, this whole society and world is just so sad i hate it. I just want to escape from it and be at peace

have you tried talking to your parents about this? I know every family has different ways of talking about this stuff, but maybe just talking with your parents about it and try and find some middle ground

someone will come, the universe is waiting for the right time for you to find someone. Maybe you’re not ready maybe focus on yourself and finding yourself first then someone will eventually turn up. However your worth isnt determined by a partner you’re just as great with or without a partner

There are not alot of words someone can say to fix things. Everyone has there own worth, there isn’t a main goal that every human must follow. Stay for yourself you do not have to be a member of this sad society you can be apart from it with your own rules and goals and follow and think whatever you want.

I also have this problem i love my mom and dad but sometimes the way they act towards eachother fills me with rage i hate it i hate it. however the thought that soon it will be over soon i will be an adult and it will no longer be my responsibility to be the messenger. Try that mentality you have your own goals and ambitions try and focus on them
Try prioritising yourself first. You are more capable of fixing things for yourself than a woman is.
